Frequently asked questions

I'm a recruiter or Finance leader. What can I explore here?

Review the professional profile, experience, Finance expertise, dashboard and portfolio projects. Contact me to discuss relevant Finance Operations, R2R, Controllership or transformation opportunities.

Can I enquire about bookkeeping or accounting support?

Yes. Describe your requirements, systems, jurisdiction and expected scope. Availability, team arrangements and responsibilities must be confirmed before any engagement is agreed.

Does the market analytics section provide stock recommendations?

No. It is intended for general financial education and analytical demonstrations, not personalised advice or stock-specific buy, sell or hold calls.

Does the chatbot use an AI API?

No. The current assistant is a guided interface with predefined choices and a free email hand-off. It does not use a paid AI API.

Finance Transformation Lab · BRS Automation

Reconciliation, with control built in.

Turn bank and ERP exports into a structured reconciliation review. Match transactions, surface exceptions and download a traceable working file—without sending selected CSV contents to a server in this browser-based prototype.

Try the BRS workspace ↓Explore membership

Prototype notice: exact reference + amount matching only. Not yet a production accounting control or a guarantee of complete reconciliation.

01 · Import

Bring your files

Start with CSV exports from a bank statement and ERP bank book. Validate headers and amount fields before processing.

02 · Reconcile

Match and investigate

Use one-to-one matching by normalized reference and amount. Duplicate, missing or ambiguous records should be investigated—not silently cleared.

03 · Export

Keep a review trail

Download matched and exception rows for review. Compare totals and obtain finance-owner approval before posting or closing.

BRS automation workspace

Upload CSV files with a header row. The prototype reads the selected files in your browser. It does not upload them, and this page does not connect to your bank, ERP or payment provider.

Choose both CSV files, map the required columns, and run reconciliation. For a quick preview, load the fictional sample.

Important limitations: CSV only; exact normalized reference and amount matching; one-to-one matching; no date tolerance, FX, fee logic, split/combined transactions or automatic journal posting. Duplicate references and ambiguous records are exceptions. Always verify row counts, opening/closing balances and totals against source systems. Do not upload employer, customer or other confidential financial data unless you have explicit authorization.
